description: This file defines the KeyPreviewsController interface, which manages the display and hiding of key preview popups in a keyboard application.

classes.name: KeyPreviewsController
classes.description: Interface for controlling key preview popups, including showing, hiding, and destroying previews.

methods.name: hidePreviewForKey
methods.description: Hides the preview popup for a specific key.

methods.name: showPreviewForKey
methods.description: Displays a preview popup for a key with an icon.
